logMetrics.name: llt_login_denials
logMetrics.description: Denied login HTTP requests; no credential or identifier labels
logMetrics.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND (resource.labels.service_name="verifypassengerlogin" OR resource.labels.service_name="verifydriverlogin") AND httpRequest.status>=400 AND httpRequest.status<500

logMetrics.name: llt_rejected_access
logMetrics.description: Rejected protected HTTP requests; no user, network or tour labels

logMetrics.name: llt_worker_errors
logMetrics.description: Function worker failures and unhandled HTTP server errors

logMetrics.name: llt_notification_health_reports
logMetrics.description: One schema-2 queue health heartbeat per receipt scheduler invocation; no identifier labels
logMetrics.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="processnotificationreceipts" AND jsonPayload.message="Notification queue health" AND jsonPayload.schemaVersion=2

logAlerts.filter: jsonPayload.message="Notification queue health" AND (jsonPayload.queues.fanout.critical.oldestDueAgeMs>120000 OR jsonPayload.queues.fanout.operational.oldestDueAgeMs>300000 OR jsonPayload.queues.retry.critical.oldestDueAgeMs>120000 OR jsonPayload.queues.receipt.critical.oldestDueAgeMs>900000 OR jsonPayload.queues.retry.operational.oldestDueAgeMs>600000 OR jsonPayload.queues.receipt.operational.oldestDueAgeMs>900000)

jsonPayload.message="Notification queue health" AND (jsonPayload.queues.fanout.marketing.oldestDueAgeMs>3600000 OR jsonPayload.queues.retry.marketing.oldestDueAgeMs>3600000 OR jsonPayload.queues.receipt.marketing.oldestDueAgeMs>3600000)

logAlerts.displayName: LLT account deletion delayed or failed

logAlerts.filter: jsonPayload.message="Media upload cleanup health" AND jsonPayload.oldestDueAgeMs>3600000

existingDiagnostics.mobile: Review sanitized crash diagnostics by exact release version; alert on new fatal signatures or a material crash-free-session decrease after a sufficient sample. Do not infer rates without a session denominator.
existingDiagnostics.usage: Enable Cloud Monitoring request/latency/instance metrics and billing-budget actual/forecast notifications with owner-entered amounts. Review RTDB downloads, Storage egress and Functions CPU/instance time.
existingDiagnostics.hardBounds: Retain declared Function maxInstances/concurrency/timeouts, database batch limits, media byte/pixel bounds and aggregate Expo provider budget. Budget alerts do not cap spending. Do not disable essential services automatically.

conditions.displayName: No schema-2 health reports for ten minutes

activationRequirements: Attach the owner-verified notification channel before enabling.
Confirm a real schema-2 heartbeat reaches the metric after policy creation; a never-started service is not proved monitored.
In an isolated environment, suppress heartbeats for over ten minutes and confirm the incident and notification, then confirm recovery.
